t: This is Warm Shores, a group of sculptures by Thomas J Price. Price is a British artist, born in 1981, who works as a sculptor. His figure Reaching Out, his first full-figure representation of a woman, has been shown as part of The Line in East London. He was also selected to create the artwork unveiled in 2022 commemorating the Windrush generation at Hackney Town Hall. Look at the figures here one by one, and notice how each of them is shaped and posed.
